title: Locate the comment box on a Hacker News reply or item page
task: Find the textarea used for replying so a human-approved comment can be filled in.

steps.note: Both the item page and the reply page use this same box.

caveats: Verified on a reply page on 2026-08-11 by the author.
HN rate-limits and kills spammy or link-heavy comments from new accounts. This recipe locates the box; whether to post is your call.
Do not check liveness by curl + grep: HN answers a burst with HTTP 429 and a 6-byte body, which looks identical to a hidden comment. Use the Firebase API's `dead` field.
author: jeet-dhandha
